patthana15.72:1.1: araṇaṃ vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana15.72:2.1: saraṇaṃ vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: araṇaṃ vipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: dve.
patthana15.72:3.1: araṇaṃ nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. saraṇaduka upādinnupādāniyattike nasaraṇaduka naupādinnupādāniyattikaṃ
